prompts.dhole: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single original creature reference for Meshy image-to-3D, Thai Native Online RPG. Create exactly ONE beautiful Southeast Asian dhole (หมาไน), a level-three fast pack-hunting enemy. Full body isolated on a plain warm light-grey studio background; no text, props, pedestal or costume. Soft stylized 3D anime MMORPG animal sculpt with broad hand-painted colour regions, coherent with a chestnut wild boar, tawny macaque and olive rice-field cobra. Natural lean athletic canine anatomy, NOT a wolf or domestic dog: rusty reddish-brown coat, warm cream throat and belly, short rounded triangular upright ears, fairly short broad muzzle, black nose, two amber-brown eyes, a single moderately bushy tail with a dark brown tip. Four correctly jointed separated limbs, two forelegs and two digitigrade hind legs. Neutral quadrupedal weight-bearing stance, four separate paws planted on one ground plane, visible front elbows, hind stifles forward and hocks backward with normal heel elevation. Paws have four weight-bearing toes with short claws; foreleg dewclaws may remain discreet, no humanoid fingers. Full body in a front three-quarter view facing camera-left, head aligned with the spine and looking in the same direction as the chest; legs separated from belly for clean rigging. Closed mouth and alert expression, no huge teeth. Broad sculpted fur clumps only at cheek, chest and tail, mostly smooth coat on legs and torso; no individual hair noise. Soft even studio light and a faint contact shadow. Keep the complete animal and tail inside frame. Avoid extra limbs or heads, crossed legs, backward paws, flat human feet, exaggerated wolf mane, fox proportions, harnesses, armour, markings, black baked shadows, extreme perspective and photorealism.
prompts.phibpa: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single original forest-spirit creature reference for Meshy image-to-3D, Thai Native Online RPG. Create exactly ONE beautiful ผีป่า, a level-three Thai forest spirit of the earth element, designed as a mysterious floating woodland guardian. Full body isolated on a plain warm light-grey studio background, no text, weapons, props, pedestal, smoke or particle effects. Soft stylized 3D anime MMORPG sculpt with broad hand-painted colours, coherent with warm tawny macaque and olive cobra assets. Distinct readable silhouette: one rounded carved teak-wood mask face with two softly luminous muted jade eyes, a simple broad carved nose, small calm closed mouth and a rounded lower face; no human skin or sharp chin. One short neck and compact humanoid-like bark torso covered in layered moss-green and muted jade broad leaves. A small asymmetrical crown of broad banyan leaves and two short blunt woody branch tips, not elaborate antlers. Exactly TWO separate arms with natural shoulder/elbow/wrist alignment, brown bark forearms, humanoid hands each with FIVE short gently curved digits including an opposable thumb, fingers pointing down with normal palms facing inward; no claws or twisted wrists. Neutral symmetrical relaxed A-pose with arms about thirty degrees away from torso, hands separated from body and all anatomy readable for rigging. One tapered continuous hanging lower body of thick vine-woven roots and leaf layers; no human legs, no feet. Five thick separated root tassels hang down from the lower torso in a gentle uneven hem, forming the single skirt-like lower silhouette, without knots, crossings or disconnected floating parts. Brown wood and earth, rich moss greens, pale sage leaf edges, restrained jade eye accents, matte organic surfaces. Front three-quarter studio view with mask facing the same direction as chest, gentle perspective, entire crown and root hem in frame. Even soft light and faint contact shadow. Charming supernatural threat, no gore, skulls, horror wounds, metal armour, tiny leaf noise, translucent surfaces, large glowing effects, extra faces, additional arms or digit mutations. Keep all leaves attached to the torso or crown, suitable for one solid textured game mesh.
